specification.title: The Field Observations of Elian Vey

thicknessBudgetMm.note: Turn-ins occupy perimeter recesses; hardware and curved spine projections are measured separately.

closed.includes: All furniture parts including coverings, repair and fittings; excludes stand and ground.

open.includes: All furniture parts including coverings, repair and fittings; excludes stand and ground.

midTurn.includes: All furniture parts including coverings, repair and fittings; excludes stand and ground.

coordinates: Runtime metres: X across the spread; Y up; Z along the spine. Specification and drawings use millimetres. Bounds are pose-dependent.

references.title: Science History Institute · Book anatomy
references.use: Anatomy, gatherings, supported sewing, board attachment; no dimensions inferred.

references.title: Princeton · Clasps, furniture, and closures
references.use: Strap, anchor, hook and catch relationship; proposed contemporary reconstruction.

references.title: Library of Congress · Structural book models
references.use: Structural modelling method and distinction between regional binding traditions.

references.title: ETH Zurich · Book simulation
references.use: Selective page interaction reference. Runtime here uses controlled geometry, not their solver.

references.title: Science History Institute · Alchemical miscellany
references.use: Use-related soiling and annotations. Its parchment is not represented as rag-paper evidence.

front-cover.description: Shaped 4 mm board, separate calfskin face, wrapped edges, tapered turn-ins, pastedown and flattened lacing ends.
front-cover.method: Closed paired surfaces; periodic closed profile sweep; true inner-board channels and compressed tooling.
front-cover.verification: Source mesh topology, board-plane paper clearance, close-up clay and material captures.
front-cover.uncertainty: Wood and calf identity are proposed. Corner folding is an interpretation; concealed through-edge lacing passages remain schematic.

rear-cover.description: Corresponding covered board with separate brass protective fittings and finished reverse.
rear-cover.method: Mirrored, rewound closed components with separate furniture.
rear-cover.verification: Topology and underside review; paper-to-board witnesses.
rear-cover.uncertainty: Protective fitting dimensions and fastening are proposed; manufacturing readiness is not established.

paper.description: 240 writing leaves of 0.16 mm nominal thickness in 24 gatherings; six representative printed spreads.
paper.method: Normal-offset capped shells, independent front/back UVs, controlled arc-length page curves; closed distance proxies replace concealed microdetail.
paper.verification: Actual vertex thickness, width preservation, 313 motion states plus 36 endpoint refinements; independent cross-section SAT witnesses.
paper.uncertainty: Kinematic illustration; no calibrated friction, moisture response, or stress solver. Five longitudinal sections do not prove all 3D contacts.

binding.description: Five tapered supports, bifolium returns, 55 mm neutral spine path, 0.05 mm proposed adhesive film, lining, endbands and caps.
binding.method: Closed normal-offset surfaces, capped sweeps, periodic thread loops and rigidly transformed resting folds.
binding.verification: All default source solids audited; active leaf audited throughout motion. Head, gutter and rear captures.
binding.uncertainty: Concealed sewing, glue, coupled fold deformation and through-edge cord passages are proposed interpretations, not an archaeological reconstruction.

clasps.description: Leather operating straps, bent brass hooks, broad strap clamps and raised staple catches.
clasps.method: Closed thick curved strips, shaped solid crossbars and posts; release occurs before cover opening.
clasps.verification: Independent hook/catch envelopes and bounded intended tip contacts; browser release-order checks.
clasps.uncertainty: Strap stress, pin tolerances, wear and friction have not been physically calibrated.

repair.description: Replacement lower-spine leather patch with tapered edges and linen stitches.
repair.method: Closed paired surfaces bonded to the spine in its material frame; capped stitch sweeps.
repair.verification: Source topology and repair isolation/close-up captures.
repair.uncertainty: Patch thickness and stitching history are authored. Sewn penetration at roots is intentional; every stitch interface is not independently certified.

support.description: Adjustable timber reading frame with separate pads and shaped support posts.
support.method: Closed frame rails; post tops follow each tilted pad plane.
support.verification: Actual pad-local corner witnesses and floor clearance at seven opening angles.
support.uncertainty: Externally controlled support demonstration; no automatic gravity or load calculation.

ground.uncertainty: Neutral presentation fixture, not part of the historical object.
